subject.title: feat(kimi): show code quota in usage status

question: Should OpenClaw’s bundled Kimi Coding provider automatically poll the official managed usage endpoint for existing Kimi credentials so usage appears in status surfaces?
rationale: The patch is mechanically bounded and follows the existing provider-owned usage-hook shape, but enabling a new automatic credential-backed network behavior is a product and compatibility decision rather than a defect a reviewer can settle from code alone.

options.title: Accept managed Kimi usage polling
options.body: Merge the current plugin-owned, official-endpoint-only behavior after CI confirms the reviewed head and merge result.

options.title: Keep Kimi usage external
options.body: Do not add bundled quota polling and instead require an external plugin or integration for users who want Kimi quota visibility.

recommendation.title: Accept managed Kimi usage polling
recommendation.body: Merge the current plugin-owned, official-endpoint-only behavior after CI confirms the reviewed head and merge result.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main ownership needs a targeted history check of the provider-usage and Kimi plugin paths before a named decision owner can be assigned.
